instructions: Read the entire supplied first line and exact quoted continuation. No gold wording is required.
pair: one new line completes AA with the supplied first line.

aabb: judge the entire three-line continuation plus supplied first line as ONE four-line AABB stanza. rhyme=true only if BOTH adjacent AA pairs rhyme under contextual stress; identical endwords are not rhyme.
Never repair grammar, imagine missing lines, replace words, or choose only a good part. Null/empty views receive all zeros and false flags.
source_complete is the generator claim; exact_requested_line_count is independent metadata. If either is false, rhyme and joint must be false. Other scores assess the exact available text.
Five integer scores0..2: relevance, progress, logic, naturalness, classical style. total=sum out of10.
meaning_acceptable/rhyme are true,false,unclear; joint=true iff both are exactly true. Modest natural scenes are enough; no masterpiece is required.
Return every card once: id, quote exactly equal to text (including null/LF), scores, total, meaning_acceptable, rhyme, joint, and specific nonempty reason.
Cards may represent identical complete views; every original slot still counts separately. Readers are separate opinions, not extra cases.
